name: Man
overview: Scripture reveals that man was uniquely created by God in His own image, as seen in Genesis 1:26-27, with a special role to exercise dominion over the earth and its creatures. The formation of man from the dust and the impartation of life by God's breath in Genesis 2:7 highlight both his physical origin and spiritual nature. Furthermore, man's authority over creation is emphasized through Adam's naming of the animals (Genesis 2:19-20), demonstrating his responsibility and stewardship as designed by God.
